sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Swift Retribution is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "So? Feel how smooth it runs now? You did me a solid with the wheels. Now we can start thinking about the fuckers who robbed my base. They can't have gotten far, they're probably still in the nature reserve. Go and punish those fucks, will you?"

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +16,000 EXP
- BTR Driver Rep +0.03
- 85,000 Roubles
- 1× Old house room key
- 1× Old house toilet key
"Nice work! Now the Scavs will think twice before messing with me."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to eliminate 10 Scavs on Woods.
